newsitem.title: JAPAN: Six markets meet going "very smoothly"-- Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: Six markets meet going "very smoothly"-- Sakakibara.

text.p: Japanese Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara told Reuters that the meeting of six markets in Tokyo on Tuesday had been going very smoothly.
Asked how the meeting between finance and central bank officials of Japan, the United States, Australia, Hong Kong, Singapore and China was progressing, he replied: "Very smoothly".
"We have been concentrating on macroeconomic conditions in the morning".
Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, added that the six would discuss financial markets and foreign exchange in the afternoon session.

Asked if U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers and Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka would discuss foreign exchange rates in their bilateral meeting to be held shortly, he replied: "Not any specific sort of topics."
